podcast.title: Gabber Derivative Post-Decline
podcast.body: Following Gabber's commercial decline, harder trance styles, referred to as "trance más duro," became more prominent at festivals. These genres inherited some of Gabber's intensity and energy, representing a continuation of hard electronic music. "el género dejó de sonar en fiestivales a favor de estilos derivados, como Hartstein o el tráncemas duro."
